description_html:
Finish polishing this. Complete Twinkle M4 Pack Valve animations adapted to the model

 I grabbed the model from this mod because it resembles the M4A1 from CS 1.6
 https://gamebanana.com/mods/607282

 I'm not sure if it's necessary since I tested it and it doesn't require "mp_consistency 0" But put it in a file like "autoexec.cfg" or "server.cfg and listenserver.cfg" just in case you need it.

Graphics Mod: https://gamebanana.com/wips/74956
